deduplication_contract: VOL periods are reused only when their complete [decision_week, ticker] boolean eligibility matrices are byte-for-byte identical. Because downstream portfolio simulation receives VOL only through this boolean matrix, identical matrices imply identical targets and portfolio evolution for every GAP/Signal/Momentum combination.

independent_snapshot_check.method: Recomputed sample variance directly for VOL 2..60 on the exact run #33 market snapshot and regrouped the resulting boolean eligibility matrices independently of the optimizer prefix-sum grouping.
independent_snapshot_check.result: Exactly the same 8 VOL groups were reproduced.

interpretation: The search covers the entire 65,609,888-row logical parameter grid, but it did not execute 65,609,888 independent portfolio simulations. 8,896,256 physical simulations were sufficient because exact-equivalent VOL gates were memoized. This is exact reuse, not heuristic pruning or approximation.
